refnamediv.refpurpose: Construct JSON variants of any type

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: sd_json_build() constructs a JSON variant from a description of its structure, passed as variadic arguments, and returns it in ret. The description must consist of exactly one top-level value, which may be of any JSON type: an object, an array, a string, a number, a boolean or null. It is generated with the SD_JSON_BUILD_…() macros, which may be nested arbitrarily to build up complex objects and arrays in a single call. See SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT3 for a description of all of them.
sd_json_buildv() is similar, but takes the description as va_list.

sd_json_buildo() is a macro that wraps its arguments in SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(), and is a shortcut for the common case of building an object at the top level. Unlike sd_json_build() it hence can only be used to build JSON objects, and its arguments must be a list of object fields, i.e. of SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR…() macros. This means sd_json_buildo(&v, SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_STRING("foo", "bar")); is equivalent to sd_json_build(&v, SD_JSON_BUILD_OBJECT(SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_STRING("foo", "bar")));

Any objects generated, at any nesting level, are subject to the same rules as objects created with sd_json_variant_new_object3, in particular each key may only be used once within the same object. If the description contains the same key more than once in the same object, the call fails with -ENOTUNIQ. Fields suppressed with SD_JSON_BUILD_PAIR_CONDITION() do not count. Note that this check happens at runtime, hence code that conditionally generates fields needs to make sure that the conditions of fields of the same name are mutually exclusive.

refsect1.title: Return Value
refsect1.para: On success, these functions return 0. On failure, they return a negative errno-style error code.

refsect2.title: Errors
refsect2.para: Returned errors may indicate the following problems:

listitem.para: An argument is invalid, or the description is not well-formed (for example, a value is specified where an object field is expected).
An object would contain the same key more than once.

refsect1.title: History
refsect1.para: sd_json_build(), sd_json_buildv() and sd_json_buildo() were added in version 257.
Before version 263 objects with duplicate keys were accepted by these functions.
